title: Round 24 · what a hit feels like
description: Whole songs in Hokusai, the same ride in four ways of feeling a hit. Switch at the same moment, with sound.

videos.description: The thud, the split, the flash toward the paper.

videos.label: B · Punch
videos.description: The camera punches in; the colours surge.

videos.label: C · Punch, a thud for the biggest
videos.description: Every hit punches; the strongest also thud.
